purpose: Compare Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode as harnesses on the same complex maintenance incident while holding the hosted model, prompt, fixture, permissions, and time limit constant.
decision_target: Test whether the earlier shared-model harness findings still hold on difficult debugging, and whether OpenCode remains a credible secondary harness when model quality is fixed.

shared_model.availability_check: ollama list succeeded immediately before preregistration
shared_model.reason: This is the strongest identical hosted route already verified through all three harness adapters without using OpenRouter.

baseline.resolution: Use the clean Git commit containing this preregistration file for all three runs. Capture the exact commit independently in each manifest.

order.command: npm run benchmark:run -- --assistant opencode --task T6-rejected-promise-cache --model ollama/kimi-k2.7-code:cloud --execute
npm run benchmark:run -- --assistant codex --task T6-rejected-promise-cache --model ollama/kimi-k2.7-code:cloud --execute
npm run benchmark:run -- --assistant claude --task T6-rejected-promise-cache --model ollama/kimi-k2.7-code:cloud --execute

acceptance.pass_rule: All visible and private checks pass, the incident note contains all requested sections with a correct diagnosis, and every changed path is allowed.

rules: Execute in the preregistered order without substituting a harness or model.
Use a fresh isolated worktree and non-persistent session for every run.
Preserve failures, partial patches, permission errors, quota errors, and timeouts as results.
Do not rerun a route inside this block and do not repair one harness's result with another.
Do not show private checks or the removed maintainer reference to any assistant.
Do not use OpenRouter, enable Anthropic usage credits, or increase any account limit in this block.
Do not treat a wrapper-reported zero cost as proof of zero underlying Ollama Cloud cost.
Use the top-frontier block for product-pairing conclusions and this block only for harness conclusions.
Do not claim a general winner from one run per harness.
